source: Half Dome, Yosemite: photogrammetry mesh (Sketchfab-style FBX download) with its diffuse textures
units: m (approx., scan scaled so the relief is ~1430 m)
notes: x/z horizontal, y up; origin below the summit at the scan's lowest height. Area-weighted surface samples, true texture RGB, s byte = uniform random. Pre-shuffled. Density fades out over the last ~300 m of the scan footprint.
